# voidauth_proxyauth (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain (supports wildcards) matched for ProxyAuth. The server stores it in normalized wildcard form (app.example.com becomes app.example.com/*); the configured spelling is kept in state.
- `max_session_length` (Number)

### Optional

- `groups` (List of String)
- `mfa_required` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
